version.finding: Original solo-piano Nocturne with pickup, written returns and complete free cadenza, no inserted repeat. No gross form/cut/arrangement mismatch identified; this is not an ornament-by-ornament transcription or authentication of Lévy's physical performing edition.

recordingProvenance.finding: The actual recording file page identifies Frank Lévy playing this Nocturne; it does not identify his performing edition. This recording identity is separate from the symbolic score's Schirmer-source attribution and CC BY-SA3 license.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or full-site browser integration run by VerS. Individual native SVG inspection is not an integrated hall test. Warped written holds do not measure key releases; pitch/onset gates do not establish every ornamental attack.
